findings.partialRejection: I did not use the reviewer's clause '立ち上がり50%の定義では約0.15秒'. It is not reproducible. With the verifier's own 50 % onset (v_kerb_compare.json: cgCross - own50 = ownFirstCrossMinusT1 - ownImuMinusT1), k1 per lap is L1 -0.063, L2 +0.071, L3 +0.078, L4 +0.022, L5 +0.104, L6 +0.023 s (median 0.047 s). The same subtraction reproduces the verifier's all / excl_k1 medians exactly. 0.148 s is the median of own50MinusT1 at k1, which is the gap between the two onset rules, not a 3DCG lag. Under both rules k1 is 0.19-0.27 s later than the other kerbs, and that is what the page now says.

findings.whatChanged: B 限界: new bullet. It says the ±0.03 s is measured at the 50 % point of the yaw-rate rise. Because the 3DCG heading comes from a ±0.6 s GPS chord, the visible turn-in (10 % point) matches the gyro in the median (7/30 +0.01 s, 7/29 -0.08 s), but 1 in 10 is off by 0.36 s or more (7/29: 0.76 s), and every large deviation is the 3DCG turning early. Against the steering onset the 3DCG turn-in is a median 0.14 s later (7/29: 0.24 s), but in 8 of 40 cases on 7/30 (2 of 26 on 7/29) the nose starts turning before the steering (up to 0.9 s; the gyro does this in 2 cases per day). これで何が言えるか bullet 1 gained one clause pointing to it. 正解の決め方 'ステアの切り始め' now states the 50 % rule and that the 10 % point and the steering onset were recorded.
